component.name: Owlo
component.summary: Play the TV, movies and series of your own subscription
Reproduce la TV, las películas y las series de tu propia suscripción

description.p: Owlo is a player for the TV subscription you already have. Sign in, add your own M3U playlist or Xtream-compatible login, and Owlo organises everything into a clean, fast interface built for the big screen, the mouse and the keyboard.

ul.li: Home with Continue watching, your favourites and recommendations from your own playlist
Movies and series with posters, synopsis, seasons and episodes; resume where you left off
Live TV with a programme guide, now/next and quick zapping
Watch several channels at once with multiview
Profiles for the family, parental control with PIN that hides adult content
Audio track and subtitle selection, keyboard shortcuts
Your account, lists and progress sync with Owlo on your TV, phone and tablet

description.p: Owlo does not provide, sell or host any channels, movies or other content. You need your own subscription or playlist from a legal provider, and you are responsible for the content you add.

Owlo es un reproductor para la suscripción de TV que ya tienes. Entra, añade tu propia lista M3U o tus datos compatibles con Xtream, y Owlo lo ordena todo en una interfaz rápida para la pantalla grande, el ratón y el teclado.
Owlo no ofrece, vende ni aloja canales, películas ni ningún otro contenido. Necesitas tu propia suscripción o lista de un proveedor legal, y eres responsable del contenido que añades.
